goals: Answer guest questions strictly from Airbnb support policy, and honestly refuse questions the policies do not cover. Ground every answer; never fabricate a number, timeframe, or policy.
iteration_protocol: Fix one variable at a time (per the blog): first fix the model and vary the prompt, then fix the prompt and vary the model, then fix both and vary the serving configuration. Virtual-judge results narrow the candidate pool at each stage.

experiments.name: baseline
experiments.change: Measure the starting configuration (gpt-5.6-luna, retrieval_k=4, baseline prompt) across all three evaluation layers.

experiments.name: prompt-tighten
experiments.change: Fix the model; tighten the refusal instruction in SYSTEM_PROMPT (edit src/edd/app.py) to cut fabrications on clean negatives.

experiments.name: model-gpt4o
experiments.change: Fix the (kept) prompt; re-run on the generator gpt-5.6-luna (no model change — both endpoints now use gpt-5.6-luna) to confirm the groundedness baseline holds.

experiments.name: retrieval-k2
experiments.stage: 3 - fix model & prompt, vary serving config
experiments.change: Fix model and prompt; vary retrieval breadth retrieval_k 4 -> 2.
